facts.fact: Niger's communication minister carried out provisional reception on 14 November 2025 of the Niger component of the trans-Saharan fibre backbone: 1,031 km on five axes to the Algerian, Chadian, Nigerian, Beninese and Burkinabe borders, laid by the LORYNE group with AfDB support; the minister spoke of commercial interconnection with Algeria, Chad, Nigeria and Benin as coming soon.

systems.owner: Niger government, financed by the African Development Bank
